in_hebrew.name: יוח
in_hebrew.long_meaning: יוֹכַח (Yōkhāḥ) in Hebrew means ‘to remember’ or ‘to call to mind’.

in_greek.name: Ιωάχ
in_greek.long_meaning: Ἰωάχ (Iōách) in Greek means ‘Jehovah is my God’ or ‘the Lord is my God’.

in_latin.name: Iovach
in_latin.long_meaning: Iovachus is a Latin name derived from the Hebrew name יוֹכַח (Yōkhāḥ) which means ‘Jehovah is my God’ or ‘the Lord is my God’.
